{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Display basic info to check structure
print(data.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(data.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print('\nNumber of duplicate patient_id rows:', data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq (re-tests)
duplicates = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print('\nNumber of patients with multiple sample_seq:', duplicates['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print('\nUnique assay_batch values:', data['assay_batch'].unique())
print('\nSample of biomarker_final values for batch B:', data[data['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].head())"}
